# Recipes Every dish here starts the same way: lay your ingredients out on a [bold]prep board[/bold], chop what needs chopping, and use [bold]Put together[/bold]. Some dishes are ready to eat straight off the board. Most still need the heat: a turn in a hearth's oven, or a sizzle in a pan on the hob. The board's own window shows which dishes you're closest to and what's still missing, so keep it open while you work.
Liquids count too. Anything a recipe needs, like water or milk, can sit on the board in a jug, a glass or a beaker, or in the very bowl the dish is served in.
The cards below show what goes in and what comes out. Ingredients marked "or similar" take any of a few close cousins.
## From the prep board Home-cooked dishes put together on the board, then finished on the hearth.
